item.title: Hochul proposes banning ICE cooperation by local police
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has introduced legislation that would prohibit local law enforcement agencies from cooperating with mass ICE operations.

item.description: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. (WIVT/WBGH) - The Binghamton Philharmonic Orchestra is opening the New Year in "Classic Style."
